name: Def Leppard Pyromania
reference: Photograph (~124 BPM) / Rock of Ages (~106 BPM): Def Leppard, Pyromania (1982 sessions at Park Gate and Battery Studios, prod. Robert John 'Mutt' Lange, eng. Mike Shipley)
rig: Pete Willis and Steve Clark rhythm beds (Les Paul low end, SG mids, Telecaster top, up to six tracks), Phil Collen solos (Photograph: Ibanez Destroyer into a 50 W Marshall); Shipley: 'we ended up with just a little Marshall combo amp', miked with Neumann U87 / U67s; guitars recorded dry, to a Linn LM-1 click
notes: Dual rig for the Willis / Clark beds: the same 1980 Marshall JMP 2204 50 W (the 2104 combo's circuit; matches Collen's '50 W Marshall' and Shipley's small combo) on both sides, panned L/R, into a G12M Greenback 4x12 miked with a U87 (Shipley's mic). The right side has single-coil pre-EQ for Clark's Telecaster 'top end' layer; Align wobble 0.2 for the stacked takes. Equipboard's 100 W 2203 heads conflict with the stronger Shipley/Collen sources. SW8 BOOST = TS9 push (not on the record); SW9 DELAY = 363 ms (dotted eighth at Photograph's 124 BPM; Rock of Ages would be 425 ms). 480L Large Plate at 15% is a polished-mix guess (Lange's desk effects are undocumented). Research: the 80s-tones.md shortlist (captures and model ids checked with `tone3000.py models`). On the board (bank 1): SW8 = BOOST (slot 1), SW9 = DELAY (slot 5 / R3). Levels are unmeasured.
